newsitem.title: USA: American Express, AT&T Capital in venture.
newsitem.headline: American Express, AT&T Capital in venture.

text.p: American Express Co and AT&T Capital Corp on Tuesday announced a 50-50 joint venture, American Express CapitaFinance LLC, to provide equipment finance to small business owners.

The venture will offer a service called American Express Equipment Financing which offers up to $25,000 via direct marketing. It enables a broader range of equipment to be financed than a traditional manufacturer lease, they said.

AT&T Capital was spun off by AT&T Corp in 1993, and in 1996 the telephone company sold its remaining stake to a consortium led by GRS Holding with 85 percent, Babcock & Brown 10 percent, and management five percent.
